title: Dashboard
subtitle: Real-time overview of agent activity
noAgentsDesc: Agents will appear here when a monitored session is running.

filters.label: Filters
filters.statsGlobalNote: Cards follow the period; "Events today" keeps its own fixed day. Provider scope lives in Settings → Dashboard Data.

noAgentsFilteredDesc: Widen the period, or clear the agent and provider filters.
